args.lesson: Worked: GitHub search with commenter:app/opirebot finds the issues Opire is attached to in one fetch (120 open). The saved Opire homepage lists no tasks. Failed: none of the 15 screened issues was a funded upstream task. Every $-labelled issue was a $10 template on a copied repo owned by a name+digits account, and $10 is below Opire's stated $20 minimum. The only bounded upstream fix (slick#3945, Scala 3.10 'with' to '&' in generated code) had no reward ('this issue does not have any reward yet!') and the reporter had already linked a PR. The bot being present does not mean money is attached. Next time: do not reopen GitHub bounty channels (Algora, labels, reactions or Opire are all now STOP). Reconsider only with a specific maintainer-funded fiat reward of at least USD 20 with fewer than 5 attempts, plus a founder-approved GitHub identity. Spend the turns on the live offers and the deadline duties instead.
